desc.zh: 固定一个座位对，找回伴侣；用环证明交换次数最少。
desc.en: Repair one seat pair at a time, then prove the swap count with cycles.

complexity: O(n) time; O(n) auxiliary space, where n is the number of couples

concepts.name: Fixed prefix and position map
concepts.description: Repair a seat block while preserving completed blocks and exact person positions.

concepts.name: Cycle lower bound
concepts.description: At most one component is added per swap; greedy reaches n components in n-c swaps.
